scripts.check: biome check . && npm run typecheck --workspace @wishme/app && npm test --workspace @wishme/app
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types --local --lang typescript --schema public > apps/app/src/lib/database.types.ts && biome format --write apps/app/src/lib/database.types.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run build:web --workspace @wishme/app && npm run e2e --workspace @wishme/app
